entities.name: Nepotian of Asturias
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nepotian was briefly the king of Asturias in 842. Prior to that, he served as count of the palace under his predecessor, Alfonso II, to whom he may have been related. Both the nature of this relationship and the legitimacy of his rule are disputed by historians.
